independent_checks.section_ledger: The fixed sections of (1-y)^6/(1+y^2)^5, (1-y)^7/(1+y^2)^6, (1-y)^5/(1+y^2)^5, (1-y)^7/(1+y^2)^7, and (1-y)^6/(1+y^2)^6 reproduce respectively -35(9,-10,1) and 35(9,-18,-3,6,6,-36,-9,-16,54). Degree gaps r+3,r+5,r+4 exclude all next sections.
independent_checks.reciprocity_signs: Low A and B sections give the 9-10C weights; the high B section has denominator p+n and gives J_chi plus the -J_chi/n^2 carry. The harmonic corrections have the displayed signs, while all nine quadratic sections acquire the common (-1)^r reciprocity sign. This yields C_nu/p=-35(-1)^(r+1)(S2_nu+pK_nu).
independent_checks.divisibility_interface: S2_nu mod p is checked against the frozen Item219 period. Since p>=17 makes -35 a unit and p divides C_nu identically, the bridge is equivalent to p^3|C_nu iff S2_nu+pK_nu=0 mod p^2.
independent_checks.kernel_barrier_scope: At p=17,s=2,nu=0 the independently recomputed depth-one/depth-two pairs are (4,4) at n=2 and (9,4) at n=6, producing corrected weights 12 and 199 mod 289. independent_checks.standalone_probe: A dependency-free implementation reconstructed the exact integer C_nu and separated lifted/quadratic formula on 104 (p,s,nu) triples through p<=83, and independently reproduced the p=17 barrier witness.
